title: "04_spatial_statistics"
author: "Rupesh Pandey"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---



```{r}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Script: 04_spatial_statistics.R
# Purpose: Global & Local Moran’s I (Spatial Inequality)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------



options(scipen = 999)

input_gpkg <- "~/Downloads/URBAN-INEQUALITY-IN-BARODA/data/processed/vadodara_final_index.gpkg"
output_dir <- "~/Downloads/URBAN-INEQUALITY-IN-BARODA/output/maps"

cli::cli_h1("STEP 4: Spatial Autocorrelation Analysis (Moran’s I)")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. LOAD & FIX GEOMETRY
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if (!file.exists(input_gpkg))
  cli::cli_abort("Final index not found. Run Step 3 first.")

wards <- st_read(input_gpkg, layer = "uoi_scores", quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  .[!st_is_empty(.), ]

cli::cli_alert_success("Spatial data loaded and geometries validated")
cli::cli_alert_info("Total wards analysed: {nrow(wards)}")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. SPATIAL WEIGHTS (sf-native, safe)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cli::cli_h2("Spatial Neighbour Definition")

nb <- st_contiguity(wards) # Sfdep package function
lw <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

cli::cli_alert_info("Average neighbours per ward: {round(mean(card(nb)), 2)}")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. GLOBAL MORAN’S I
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cli::cli_h2("Global Moran’s I")

global_test <- moran.test(wards$UOI_Score, lw, zero.policy = TRUE)
global_mc   <- moran.mc(wards$UOI_Score, lw, nsim = 999, zero.policy = TRUE)

global_summary <- tibble(
  Moran_I    = round(global_mc$statistic, 3),
  Expected_I = round(global_test$estimate[2], 3),
  P_value    = round(global_mc$p.value, 4)
)

print(knitr::kable(global_summary, format = "simple"))

if (global_mc$p.value < 0.05) {
  cli::cli_alert_success("Significant spatial autocorrelation detected")
} else {
  cli::cli_alert_warning("No significant spatial autocorrelation detected")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. LOCAL MORAN’S I (LISA)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cli::cli_h2("Local Moran’s I (LISA)")

local <- localmoran(wards$UOI_Score, lw, zero.policy = TRUE)

wards_lisa <- wards %>%
  mutate(
    z_uoi  = as.numeric(scale(UOI_Score)),
    lag_uoi = as.numeric(scale(lag.listw(lw, UOI_Score))),
    LISA_I = local[, "Ii"],
    LISA_p = local[, "Pr(z != E(Ii))"],
    cluster = case_when(
      LISA_p >= 0.05          ~ "Insignificant",
      z_uoi > 0 & lag_uoi > 0 ~ "High-High",
      z_uoi < 0 & lag_uoi < 0 ~ "Low-Low",
      z_uoi > 0 & lag_uoi < 0 ~ "High-Low",
      z_uoi < 0 & lag_uoi > 0 ~ "Low-High"
    )
  )

cluster_summary <- wards_lisa %>%
  count(cluster) %>%
  mutate(Percent = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1))

print(knitr::kable(cluster_summary, format = "simple"))

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. MAPPING
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cli::cli_h2("Map Generation")

if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

tmap_mode("plot") # tmap mode

map_uoi <- tm_shape(wards) +
  tm_polygons("UOI_Score",
              style = "jenks",
              palette = "-magma",
              title = "Urban Opportunity Index") +
  tm_layout(frame = FALSE)

map_lisa <- tm_shape(wards_lisa) +
  tm_polygons(
    "cluster",
    palette = c(
      "High-High" = "darkgreen",
      "Low-Low" = "red",
      "High-Low" = "orange",
      "Low-High" = "skyblue",
      "Insignificant" = "grey90"
    ),
    title = "LISA Clusters"
  ) +
  tm_borders(alpha = 0.4) +
  tm_layout(frame = FALSE)

tmap_save(map_uoi, file.path(output_dir, "01_UOI_Map.png"))
tmap_save(map_lisa, file.path(output_dir, "02_LISA_Cluster_Map.png"))

cli::cli_alert_success("All spatial statistics completed successfully")

# 6. GENERATE MORAN'S SCATTER PLOT ----------------------------------------
message("-> Generating Moran's Scatter Plot...")

# Save as PNG
png(filename = "~/Downloads/URBAN-INEQUALITY-IN-BARODA/output/maps/03_Moran_Scatter.png", width = 800, height = 600)

# Create the standard Moran Plot
moran.plot(wards$UOI_Score, lw,
           labels = as.character(wards$ward_id), 
           pch = 19, 
           col = "gray50",
           xlab = "Standardized UOI Score (Ward)", 
           ylab = "Lagged UOI Score (Neighbors)",
           main = "Moran's I Scatter Plot: Testing for Clustering")

# Add reference lines
abline(h = 0, v = 0, lty = 2, col = "gray80")

dev.off() # Close the graphics device
message("✅ Moran's Scatter Plot saved to output/maps/03_Moran_Scatter.png")

```
